segments.text: Personality:
Unlike the disturbing rumors about him, he has a calm personality. He is honest and frank but the things he says or does might come off as slightly off. He seems to be attracted to the protagonist...
Rumor of Bloodthirsty Killer "Karakara-san":
They say after school, when you hear the sound of iron being dragged in the school building at dusk, don't turn around.
If you do, you will be asked a question.
If you can't answer it or give the wrong answer, you'll be killed.
His full name is Kureha Tendou.
Personality:
He is somewhat timid and afraid of interacting with others. He shows positive and bright attitude only to the protagonist. But there are times he shows gloominess too...
Rumor of Dragging Mirror:
On the landing between the first and second floors of the central staircase, there's a full length mirror on the wall, right?
Don't touch it.
Because the ghost in the mirror will drag you to the other world.
His full name is Hibiki Ioto.
Personality:

Kouyou is a blunt and emotionally calm person. For some reason, he shows concern for the protagonist. He is knowledgeable about occultism and Kureha is his acquaintance. He and Sena are childhood friends and best friends.
Urban Legend "Mary of Happiness":
Doesn't the name "Mary" kinda give off scary vibes?
The one that suddenly calls and says "I'm Mary and I'm behind you right now."
But, apparently Mary from Narumigahama delivers the words of the dead people through his phone.
So, it is said that what Mary of Happiness delivers is a message from someone important to you who has passed away.
His full name is Kouyou Akizuki.
Personality:

Sena was a national idol during his lifetime. He is so sociable and bright that even when he's a ghost, he is shining. He always tries to give the best fan service to his fans. But whenever you meet him, you notice something about him that feels strange... He and Kouyou are childhood friends and best friends.
The Young Man Who Looks Up At the Stars
There are rumors that you can meet the ghost of S=CROWN's Sena at the Seaside Park in Narumigahama!
What, haven't you heard of it? S=CROWN is a national idol group.
Well, apparently, Sena took his last breath at the open place in the Seaside Park.
Rumor has it he was found lying on his back and looked like he was looking up at the night sky.
His full name is Sena Mikagami.
Personality:

His mood swings are intense and he always acts according to his mood. He might fake his personality to deceive others. His purpose is to make a "contract" with the protagonist and take her soul. He despises Seiya.
Incubus:
The demon who appears in the dreams of humans and causes nightmares.
There are various theories, but in order to overcome it you need a strong heart that can resist the temptation of the incubus.
Personality:

Even though Seiya acts politely and gentlemanly, he is an extremely romantic man. He is a deceased person who currently works at HO as Head Warder. He is trying to help the protagonist. He dislikes Minami.
Hell Organization:
Commonly known as HO.
A person who committed a sin while alive will arrive in hell after death.
HO purifies the corruption of the dead people by punishing them.
Most of the people who work at HO are also dead.
Personality:
Zashiki-warashi (Trainee)

On one hand he's cheerful and lively, but on the other hand he is noisy and selfish. You can tell when he's happy or sad, it's easy to understand. He appeared to make the protagonist happy and decided to follow her around on his own. He and Koharu know each other for a very long time.
-Zashiki-warashi-
There are various stories about this ayakashi. Such as if you see Zashiki-warashi, he will bring you good luck, or he will bring wealth to your home, and so on.
Personality:

He is from the Kokkuri-san clan. He might be curt and has a harsh tone but he is actually a considerate and kind ayakashi. One day, the protagonist summoned Kokkuri-san but she accidentally took her finger off the coin...
Koharu and Yukimaro have an unwanted yet inevitable connection.
-Kokkuri-san-
Kokkuri-san is an ayakashi who can be summoned.
If you follow the formal procedure, he will answer your questions.
The thing you need to be careful of is, never taking your finger off the coin while summoning him.
The main character of this work.
She is a Second Year student at Narumigahama High School.
She has a bright and kind personality, but she tends to care too much.
Ever since she was a child, she has been unhappy and has been hit by unlucky events.
She doesn't want to go to the university her mother wants, but she is unable to say so.
One night, she hears a strange voice and her daily life begins to go haywire...
Mother of the protagonist.
She is a nurse working at a large hospital in Narumigahama.
She raised her daughters single-handedly after her husband passed away.
Usually gentle and calm.
She becomes so enthusiastic about the protagonist's career path that she loses sight of her surroundings.
Sister of the protagonist.
She works in an apparel shop in Tokyo and loves her job.
She is a mood-maker in the family because of her cheerful and lively personality.
She is very protective of the protagonist and is somewhat of a siscon.
She also thinks of Sayaka as a younger sister.
When she was a student, she had a dispute with her mother Ayame about her career path, but this has now been resolved and they are on good terms.
A Second Year student at Narumigahama High School.
Classmate, childhood friend, and best friend of the protagonist.
Always cheerful and full of energy.
She is an occult fanatic and tells the protagonist various urban legends and ghost stories.
She seems to have some troubles of her own, too...
A boy from the Tengu Clan who appears in the Ayakashi Chapter.
That means he is a god...
This time, he appears in front of the protagonist to help her in fear of her being possessed by ayakashi.
He appears as a child with a distinctive tone of voice.
He seems to have been following the protagonist since childhood and his stalker remarks always stand out.
Capturable secret character
A ghost girl who the protagonist meets in various world lines.
Her true identity is one of the Seven Wonders of Narumigahama High School, the "Infirmary Girl" herself.
She has a dignified air around her but sometimes shows a dark expression.
Her full name is Yui Tsukigami.
A ghost girl the protagonist meets in one of the world lines.
Slightly older than the protagonist.
She treats the protagonist casually even when she meets her for the first time.
Priest of Tsukumo Shrine in Narumigahama.
He has spiritual power and his power is considerable.
However, his power can also work in extraordinary ways...
In some worldlines, he even helps the protagonist.
